changelog: 1.2.0 — live edit sync: elements, activity and the pursuit index now stream over onSnapshot instead of being read once at load, so another person's edit reaches the open brief without a reload. Remote changes park while a field is focused and land on blur, so a re-render can never eat what someone is typing. Comment listener reconnects with backoff instead of degrading permanently on one blip. schemaSupport raised to 4. editMode declared honestly — it shipped in 1.1.x but the manifest still said false.
1.1.0 — visual craft pass: one type scale, one row grid, one chip system, controlled measure, masthead + countdown pill, inline source disclosure, AA-safe greys.
1.0.0 — first release: 12 sections read mode, four derived components, document previews.
notes: Fetch renderer.js + renderer.css from this directory and inline both to build a standalone brief. Do not fork — improvements here re-render every hosted pursuit on redeploy. The eight-section IA (Scope / Plan / Compliance / Scorecard / Team & Burden / Questions / Risks & Signals / Record + a Documents header menu) is the next change and will land as 2.0.0; `sections` above still lists the twelve this version renders.
